capabilities: focus the existing pane when a note is already open
prevent duplicate instances of the same note across panes
preserve forced open-in-new-pane actions such as middle-clicking links
disambiguation: Not a duplicate-file finder; it only prevents the same note from being opened in two panes at once.
extras: The README warns that the plugin overrides the default Obsidian behavior by overwriting the public openLinkText() function, which also affects plugins using it; it does not apply to core features like the File Explorer, and the author points readers to an original feature request asking for this behavior in core.
intentEvidence: This plugin modifies the default behavior of Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's default link handling can replace a pane's content even when the target note is already open elsewhere, producing multiple instances of the same note.

relations.evidence: affects other plugins that use this function - like Omnisearch

summary: Tab-behavior modifier that focuses the pane already showing a note instead of opening a second copy of it.
